 On Wednesday, November 4, Dynamo Kyiv will play the second leg of the second round of the UEFA Youth League Champions Path Play-offs. As a reminder, the first match against Scottish side Rangers, which took place last week in Stalowa Wola, Poland, ended in a 3-2 victory for the Kyiv side.
 For the upcoming match, the UEFA Referees Committee has appointed a refereeing team from Switzerland.
 Referee – Anojen Kanagasingam
 Assistant referees – Bastien Lengacher, Claudio Dos Santos
 Fourth official – Lewis Hogarth (Scotland).
 As a reminder, the match Rangers U19 – Dynamo U19 will take place in the city of Stirling, 45 km from Glasgow, and will kick off at 21:00 Kyiv time.
 * Photo: Sport.ch
